posts.title: Rendered Reality
posts.description: Nick Bostrom's simulation argument was untestable metaphysics about a machine nobody had built. Two decades later engineers generate playable worlds in real time, and biology holds that no animal perceives reality as it is.

posts.title: The Coal Question Comes Back
posts.description: In 1865 William Stanley Jevons argued that the more efficiently coal was burned, the more of it Britain would burn. The same mechanism is now eating AI's promise to give us our time back.

posts.title: Area X
posts.description: Jeff VanderMeer's 2014 novel about four people who descend into a structure they cannot agree how to name — and what their disagreement says about every word we have brought to the AI encounter.
